payload.text:
I want you to generate a complete, production-ready personal portfolio website using the following tech stack:

Tech Stack:
- Next.js 14 (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Shadcn/UI components
- MDX for blog posts
- Framer Motion for subtle animations
- Responsive design (mobile-first)
- Dark/Light mode toggle
- SEO optimized
- Clean folder structure

Website Owner Details:
Name: Shivang Rathod
Title: Digital Marketer | SEO Strategist
Location: Bangalore, India
Status Badge: Available for Hire

About Section Content:
I am a performance-driven Digital Marketer with 7+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, and growth marketing. I specialize in scaling organic traffic, building content engines, and driving revenue through search.

Work Experience:
- 2025–Present: Head of SEO – JISR
- 2024–2025: Digital Marketing Manager – PromptCloud
- 2022–2024: Manager – Digital Marketing – Lifesight
- 2022–2023: Marketing Team Lead – LearnVern
- 2019–2021: Marketing Team Lead – Mconnect Solutions
- 2017–2019: Content Writer & SEO – MageComp

What I Need in the Website:

1. Hero Section:
- Large bold headline: “I’m Shivang Rathod – Digital Marketer”
- Location badge
- Green "Available for Hire" badge
- Short intro paragraph
- Primary CTA button: "Get in Touch"
- Clean minimal UI similar to modern portfolio layouts

2. Featured Projects Section:
Create dynamic project cards with:
- Project name
- Short description
- Tags (SEO, Content, SaaS, Ecommerce, etc.)
- External link icon
- Hover animation
- Grid layout

Make projects driven from a data file (JSON or TS file).

3. Blog System:
- Blog listing page (/blog)
- Individual blog pages (/blog/[slug])
- MDX support
- SEO metadata per post
- Reading time calculation
- Blog categories/tags
- Clean typography (Prose styling)

4. Tools Stack Section:
Show tools I use:
- Ahrefs
- SEMrush
- Google Analytics
- Google Search Console
- Notion
- Figma
- Slack

Display as clean icon grid cards.

5. Testimonials Section:
Card-based testimonials with:
- Name
- Designation
- Company
- Feedback text

6. Work Experience Timeline Section:
Vertical timeline layout
Year on left
Role and company on right
Minimal modern style

7. Newsletter / Contact Section:
- Name input
- Email input
- Message textarea
- Submit button
- Form validation
- Use server actions or API route
- Ready to connect to Resend or Email service

8. Footer:
- Social links (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, GitHub)
- Privacy Policy
- Copyright

Design Style Requirements:
- Minimal
- Soft shadows
- Rounded-xl cards
- Neutral color palette
- Good spacing
- Smooth animations
- Professional & modern
- Similar structure to high-end designer portfolios

Technical Requirements:
- Clean reusable components
- Proper folder structure
- Layout.tsx
- Metadata config
- Loading.tsx
- Error.tsx
- SEO optimized
- Open Graph support
- Sitemap generation
- Robots.txt
- Deployment ready for Vercel

Extra:
- Include sample blog posts
- Include sample project entries
- Use dummy images from Unsplash
- Ensure performance optimized
- No unnecessary libraries

Deliver:
- Complete project file structure
- All important files with code
- Installation steps
- How to deploy on Vercel
- How to add new blog posts
- How to add new projects

Generate everything in well-structured sections with code blocks.
Do not skip any required file.
Make it production-ready.

**Defining the Framework**

I am now focusing on selecting the right framework. I will be using Next.js 14 and making use of the App Router, as well as React 18+, ESM, and TypeScript, as requested. The original prompt stated the wrong router.


**Refining the Structure**

I'm now zeroing in on the architecture, which must reflect the system constraints. I'll maintain a SPA structure with React 18+ and `createRoot`. The Next.js 14 request can be simulated, along with blog, projects and other functionality, by high-quality content rendered with a HashRouter. Tailwind is the *only* CSS framework, so I'll utilize `lucide-react`, `framer-motion`, and `shadcn/ui` style components, all implemented with Tailwind.


**Outlining the Components**

I'm now detailing the component structure and data flow, and I am confident in the core components. I am prioritizing a minimal, neutral aesthetic with soft shadows and professional typography. I've designed the `metadata.json`, `index.html`, and `index.tsx` files. I am now focusing on the `App.tsx` layout and its subcomponents such as `Nav`, `Footer`, `Hero`, `Experience`, `Projects`, `Blog`, `Tools`, `Testimonials`, `Contact`, and `ThemeToggle` to keep things easy. Data will be fetched from the `data/` directory.



**Prioritizing System Instructions**

I am now focusing on the system instructions versus the user requests, and I am prioritizing the SPA React app with HashRouter for code generation. I've designed the code to reflect a highly optimized single-page application, and I'll explain this in comments. I'll include bold CTAs, hover cards and vertical timelines. I'll maintain an icon grid for Tools and list views with the HashRouter for Blog, and I'll use `framer-motion` for animations. I am now working on the `metadata.json` data.
